Threat: Phishing leading to credential theft and account takeover
Vulnerability: MFA not enforced for all users; some accounts use SMS codes
Existing Controls: Security awareness video at onboarding; email filtering
Recommended Action: Enforce phishing-resistant MFA (security keys or passkeys) for all staff; block legacy authentication

Threat: Unauthorized or excessive internal access to patient records
Vulnerability: 12 engineers have standing production access; no periodic access reviews
Existing Controls: SSO login; database audit logging enabled
Recommended Action: Move to just-in-time access with approval; quarterly access reviews signed off by data owner

Threat: Cloud misconfiguration exposing patient documents publicly
Vulnerability: No automated configuration scanning; changes made manually in console
Existing Controls: Block Public Access enabled at account level; encryption at rest
Recommended Action: Deploy automated cloud configuration monitoring; manage storage settings as code with review

Asset: ePHI shared with SMS reminder vendor
Threat: Vendor breach or misuse of patient data
Vulnerability: No Business Associate Agreement (BAA) signed; no vendor security review
Recommended Action: Sign BAA or replace vendor; complete vendor security questionnaire before renewal

Threat: Ransomware or destructive attack causing extended outage
Vulnerability: Backup restores never tested; backups in same AWS account
Recommended Action: Test restores quarterly; copy backups to an isolated account with immutable retention

Vulnerability: Logs collected but no alerting or regular review; no owner for monitoring
Existing Controls: CloudTrail enabled; application logs retained 30 days
Recommended Action: Define high-priority alerts (e.g. bulk ePHI export, privilege changes); assign weekly review owner; extend retention to 1 year

Threat: Lost or stolen device exposing exported patient data
Vulnerability: Full-disk encryption not enforced on ~15% of laptops; staff export CSVs for support tasks
Existing Controls: Device management tool on most laptops
Recommended Action: Enforce full-disk encryption via device management; replace CSV exports with in-app reporting

Vulnerability: No automated dependency scanning; patching done ad hoc
Recommended Action: Add dependency scanning to the build pipeline; define patching timelines by severity

Threat: Former employees retain access to systems with ePHI
Vulnerability: Offboarding is manual and relies on HR emailing IT; no deprovisioning checklist
Existing Controls: Most leavers disabled within a week
Recommended Action: Automate deprovisioning from HR system; same-day access removal target; monthly leaver audit

Threat: Slow or disorganized response to a breach, missing notification deadlines
Vulnerability: Incident response plan exists but has never been tested; roles unclear
Recommended Action: Update IR plan with HIPAA breach notification steps; run an annual tabletop exercise

Vulnerability: Shared office with badge access; no ePHI stored on premises
Recommended Action: Accept: no ePHI or production systems on premises. Review annually
